notes: Keys are the source's own identifier for a model: an AA slug or display name, a BenchLM canonical model name, or a LiveBench published model name. The matcher tries the keys exactly as written (slug first, then display name for AA) — no case folding, no substring or fuzzy matching. A key that does not exactly match a live source row simply never matches; that model stays Unranked, never 0.

A value may be a single catalog key or an array: several catalog rows serve the same base model (e.g. Llama 3.3 70B Instruct on Groq, OpenRouter and Cloudflare) and all of them legitimately share the source score.

HOW TO EXTEND: run the fetch job (dry-run) and read its unmatched-source report — every source row the job saw but could not map is listed. Add a mapping only when you are sure the catalog row is the SAME model (same weights, same variant). Variant matters: e.g. LiveBench 'Gemma 4 31B' is deliberately NOT mapped to aihubmix gemma-4-31b-it-free (base vs instruct-tuned variant), and 'MiMo V2.6 Pro' is NOT mapped to mimo-v2.6-flash rows.
